form.enabledHelp: If "Enabled", SCM-Manager offers authentication via OAuth2/OIDC.
form.forceLoginHelp: If checked, unauthenticated users are redirected to the identity provider automatically. Conventional authentication is no longer possible.
form.ssoLogoutHelp: If checked, logging out of SCM-Manager also terminates the SSO session at the identity provider (RP-initiated logout with id_token_hint via the end session endpoint).
form.migrateLocalUsersHelp: If checked, the identity provider also takes over accounts which still have a local password (the password is removed in that case). Users of other external authentications (e.g. ldap) are always migrated automatically. Without this option the login is rejected if a local account with the same name exists.
form.providerNameHelp: Display name of the identity provider. Shown on the login page as "Login with <provider name>". Required if oauth2 authentication is enabled.
form.providerNameRequired: The provider name is required if oauth2 authentication is enabled.
form.discoveryUrlHelp: Issuer URL or complete URL of the OIDC discovery document (.well-known/openid-configuration). If set, all endpoints below are resolved automatically from the discovery document and the manual entries are ignored.
form.authorizationUrlHelp: URL of the authorization endpoint of the identity provider, e.g. https://idp.example.com/realms/main/protocol/openid-connect/auth
form.tokenUrlHelp: URL of the token endpoint of the identity provider.
form.userinfoUrlHelp: URL of the OIDC userinfo endpoint of the identity provider.
form.endSessionUrlHelp: URL of the OIDC end session endpoint used for the full SSO logout. Optional, only required if "Full SSO logout" is enabled and no discovery URL is set.
form.clientIdHelp: The client id registered at the identity provider.
form.clientSecretHelp: The client secret registered at the identity provider. It is stored encrypted and never returned by the API. Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
form.scopesHelp: Space separated list of scopes requested from the identity provider, e.g. "openid profile email".
form.usernameHelp: Userinfo claim used as username (falls back to "sub").
form.displayNameHelp: Userinfo claim used as display name.
form.mailHelp: Userinfo claim used as email address.
form.groupsHelp: Userinfo claim used for group memberships.
form.adminGroupHelp: If the group claim contains this group, the user is granted the global administrator permission on login. If the group is no longer present, the permission is revoked on the next login. Leave empty to never touch permissions.
